CSS Radio Styler

Design custom radio buttons — colors, size, dot style — with a working live preview and CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick the accent color and radio size.
  2. Choose the inner dot style (filled dot or ring).
  3. Try the working preview radios.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained radio.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the custom radio work?

The native input stays functional but hidden; a styled span draws the circle and the :checked selector reveals the inner dot.

Is it accessible?

Yes — real radio inputs with labels, so keyboard navigation and screen readers work, including arrow-key group behavior.

How do I group radios?

Give all inputs in a group the same name attribute — the sample markup shows how.

Can I embed it in my page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with rd- to avoid collisions.
